extraction.Name: Sophia Dyer
extraction.Buyer: Fannie Haessler, formerly Fannie Dyer, devisee of Sophia Dyer, conveyed the land to Ernest Haessler, her husband, for $1.00, natural love and affection
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 749612 issued in favor of Fannie Dyer as devisee; northeast quarter of section 9, township 39, range 28; but there is no receipt of record; on June 9, 1924 Fannie Haessler (formerly Fannie Dyer), devisee of Sophia Dyer, conveyed the land to Ernest Haessler, her husband; Ernest Haessler recorded the patent June 11, 1924
